support_validation_R1.comparison_with_r0_draws: R0 recorded the same pipeline at pair PSNRs 28.84/24.46/29.11/37.66/17.62 (mean 27.54). R1 fresh draws mean 37.21 (+9.67 dB) with an unchanged pipeline, quantifying the stochastic-angle draw variance. This is not a degradation change.

analysis.rationale: NO_CHANGE: the R0 pipeline blur_motion:1 is confirmed, not superseded. On 5 support pairs the unchanged pipeline reaches mean 37.21 dB with two pairs above 40 dB and near-perfect CI, whereas the two signal-gap hypotheses (mild JPEG, mild saturation weaken) degrade mean PSNR by 10.77 and 14.10 dB with systematic block_boundary/color mismatches. No noise (physics bound), no compression (block_boundary 1.0156 + JPEG probe), no global (saturation probe + 0-3% unique-color match), no brightness (mean_shift -0.4). Severity=1 is retained (motion:2/3 over-blur in R0: best 26.19 dB, zcd 9-20% low). Verdict raised from UNCERTAIN to LIKELY because two independent support pairs now reproduce the target above 40 dB at CI 8-10/10 with the deterministic step.
